descriptionChirho: Gittite, a gentilic adjective denoting an inhabitant of the Philistine city of Gath; applied most notably to Obed-edom the Gittite (2 Sam 6:10) and Ittai the Gittite (2 Sam 15:19). English 'the Gittite/the Gittites', Spanish 'el guitita/los guititas', Hindi गित्ती/गत्ती, Arabic الْجِتِّيِّ/الجَتّيّينَ, Korean 가드 사람/가트 사람들, Swahili 'Mgiti/Wagiti'. Singular and plural forms denote the same gentilic identity.
